instruction: I want to increase the maximum volume limit in VLC Media Player to 200% instead of the default 125%. Could you help me change this setting so I can boost the volume higher when needed?

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires increasing the maximum volume limit in VLC to 200%. The evaluator checks the qt-max-volume setting in VLC config file. Expected value is 200. Default is 125. Uses existing check_qt_max_volume metric function.
metadata.verification: Checked existing VLC metric functions. check_qt_max_volume reads vlcrc file and verifies qt-max-volume=200. Default is 125, so task requires changing it to 200.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter logic is correct: get_vlc_config() properly reads VLC configuration file (vlcrc) from OS-specific location
Metric logic is correct: check_qt_max_volume() correctly parses config file and searches for 'qt-max-volume=' setting
Expected value is correct: 200 matches instruction requirement (200% instead of default 125%)
Complete coverage: Evaluator checks exactly what instruction requires (changing max volume limit to 200%)
Parameter handling is correct: Metric receives rules dict directly as 'rule' parameter and accesses 'expected_qt_max_volume' correctly
Postconfig is appropriate: Kills and relaunches VLC to ensure fresh config state for verification
Default handling is robust: Metric defaults to '125' if setting not found, then compares with expected value
Type conversion is handled: Metric converts int to string for comparison
